=== win copilot-proxy full switch (param + cases) ===
function copilot-proxy {
    [CmdletBinding()]
    param([Parameter(ValueFromRemainingArguments)] [string[]] $Argv)

    $bun = Get-BunLauncher
    if (-not $bun) { Write-Error "copilot-proxy: bun/bunx not found (scoop install bun)"; return }

    $port = Get-CopilotPort; $pkg = Get-CopilotPkg
    $logf = Get-CopilotLogFile; $pidf = Get-CopilotPidFile
    $action = if ($Argv -and $Argv.Count -ge 1) { $Argv[0] } else { 'status' }

    switch ($action) {
        'start' {
            if (Test-CopilotAlive) { Write-Host "copilot-proxy: already running on port $port"; return }
            if (-not (Test-Path (Get-CopilotToken))) {
                Write-Error "copilot-proxy: not authenticated yet — run 'copilot-proxy auth' first."; return
            }
            # Rotate the previous session's log (keep last 3).
            if (Test-Path $logf) {
                Remove-Item "$logf.3" -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
                if (Test-Path "$logf.2") { Move-Item -Force "$logf.2" "$logf.3" }
                if (Test-Path "$logf.1") { Move-Item -Force "$logf.1" "$logf.2" }
                Move-Item -Force $logf "$logf.1"

```text
=== win copilot-model body ===
function copilot-model {
    [CmdletBinding()]
    param([Parameter(ValueFromRemainingArguments)] [string[]] $Argv)
    $settings = '.claude/settings.local.json'
    $statef = Get-CopilotModelState
    $arg = if ($Argv -and $Argv.Count -ge 1) { $Argv[0] } else { '' }

    $target = 'state'
    if (Test-Path $settings) {
        try { if ((Get-Content -Raw $settings | ConvertFrom-Json).env.ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL) { $target = 'local' } } catch { $null = $_ }
    }

    function script:_ModelList {
        try {
            $r = Invoke-RestMethod -Uri "$(Get-CopilotBase)/v1/models" -TimeoutSec 3 -ErrorAction Stop
            return ($r.data.id | Sort-Object)
        } catch {
            Write-Host "copilot-model: proxy not reachable — showing fallback list"
            return @('claude-opus-4-8', 'claude-opus-4-7', 'claude-sonnet-5', 'claude-haiku-4-5')
        }
    }
    function script:_ModelCurrent {
        if ($target -eq 'local') { (Get-Content -Raw $settings | ConvertFrom-Json).env.ANTHROPIC_MODEL }
        else { Get-CopilotDefaultModel }
    }

    switch ($arg) {
        { $_ -in '-l', '--list' } { _ModelList; return }
        { $_ -in '-c', '--current' } {
            if ($target -eq 'local') { Write-Host "$(_ModelCurrent)  (project: $settings)" } else { Write-Host "$(_ModelCurrent)  (global: $statef)" }
            return
        }
        { $_ -in '-h', '--help' } { Write-Host "Usage: copilot-model [<model-id>|-l|-c]"; return }
    }

    $models = _ModelList
    $resolved = ''
    if (-not $arg) {
        if (-not (Get-Command fzf -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue)) { Write-Error "copilot-model: pass a model id (fzf not found). Try: copilot-model -l"; return }
        $want = $models | fzf --prompt='model> ' --height=40% --reverse --header="current: $(_ModelCurrent)"
        if (-not $want) { Write-Host 'cancelled'; return }
        $resolved = $want
    } else {
        $suffix = ''; $base = $arg
        if ($arg -match '\[1m\]$') { $suffix = '[1m]'; $base = $arg -replace '\[1m\]$', '' }
        $norm = $base -replace '\.', '-'
        foreach ($cand in @($base, "claude-$base", $norm, "claude-$norm")) {
            if ($models -contains $cand) { $resolved = $cand; break }
        }
        if (-not $resolved) {
            $hits = @($models | Where-Object { $_ -like "*$norm*" })
            if ($hits.Count -eq 1) { $resolved = $hits[0] }
            else { Write-Error "copilot-model: '$arg' did not match a unique model. Try: copilot-model -l"; return }
        }
        $resolved = "$resolved$suffix"
    }

    $old = _ModelCurrent
    if ($old -eq $resolved) { Write-Host "copilot-model: already using $resolved (no change)"; return }

    if ($target -eq 'local') {
        $obj = Get-Content -Raw $settings | ConvertFrom-Json
        $obj.env.ANTHROPIC_MODEL = $resolved
        $obj.env.ANTHROPIC_DEFAULT_OPUS_MODEL = $resolved
        $obj | ConvertTo-Json -Depth 10 | Set-Content -Path $settings -Encoding utf8
        Write-Host "copilot-model: $old -> $resolved  (project: $settings)"
        Write-Host "  restart Claude Code to apply (exit, then: claude -c)"
    } else {
        New-Item -ItemType Directory -Force -Path (Split-Path $statef) | Out-Null
        $resolved | Set-Content $statef
        Write-Host "copilot-model: $old -> $resolved  (global: $statef)"
    }
}

119	# --- shim start/stop ---
120	function script:Start-CopilotShim {
121	    if (Test-CopilotShimAlive) { return $true }
122	    if (-not (Get-Command bun -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue)) {
123	        Write-Error "copilot-proxy: shim needs 'bun' (scoop install bun)"; return $false
124	    }
125	    $script = Get-CopilotShimScript
126	    if (-not (Test-Path $script)) { Write-Error "copilot-proxy: shim script not found at $script"; return $false }
127	    $env:COPILOT_SHIM_PORT = Get-CopilotShimPort
128	    $env:COPILOT_SHIM_UPSTREAM = Get-CopilotBase
129	    $p = Start-Process -FilePath 'bun' -ArgumentList @($script) -PassThru -WindowStyle Hidden `
130	        -RedirectStandardOutput (Get-CopilotShimLog) -RedirectStandardError "$(Get-CopilotShimLog).err"
131	    $p.Id | Set-Content -Path (Get-CopilotShimPid)
132	    for ($i = 0; $i -lt 10; $i++) { if (Test-CopilotShimAlive) { return $true }; Start-Sleep 1 }
133	    Write-Error "copilot-proxy: shim did not come up — check $(Get-CopilotShimLog)"; $false
134	}
135	function script:Stop-CopilotShim {
136	    $pidf = Get-CopilotShimPid
137	    if (Test-Path $pidf) {
138	        $pid_ = Get-Content -First 1 $pidf -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
139	        if ($pid_) { Stop-Process -Id $pid_ -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue }
140	        Remove-Item $pidf -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
141	    }
142	    Get-CimInstance Win32_Process -Filter "Name = 'bun.exe'" -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue |
143	        Where-Object { $_.CommandLine -like '*copilot-throttle-shim.js*' } |
144	        ForEach-Object { Stop-Process -Id $_.ProcessId -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue }
145	}

147	# ============================================================ copilot-proxy ===
148	function copilot-proxy {
149	    [CmdletBinding()]
150	    param([Parameter(ValueFromRemainingArguments)] [string[]] $Argv)
151	
152	    $bun = Get-BunLauncher
153	    if (-not $bun) { Write-Error "copilot-proxy: bun/bunx not found (scoop install bun)"; return }
154	
155	    $port = Get-CopilotPort; $pkg = Get-CopilotPkg
156	    $logf = Get-CopilotLogFile; $pidf = Get-CopilotPidFile
157	    $action = if ($Argv -and $Argv.Count -ge 1) { $Argv[0] } else { 'status' }
158	
159	    switch ($action) {
160	        'start' {
161	            if (Test-CopilotAlive) { Write-Host "copilot-proxy: already running on port $port"; return }
162	            if (-not (Test-Path (Get-CopilotToken))) {
163	                Write-Error "copilot-proxy: not authenticated yet — run 'copilot-proxy auth' first."; return
164	            }
165	            # Rotate the previous session's log (keep last 3).
166	            if (Test-Path $logf) {
167	                Remove-Item "$logf.3" -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
168	                if (Test-Path "$logf.2") { Move-Item -Force "$logf.2" "$logf.3" }
169	                if (Test-Path "$logf.1") { Move-Item -Force "$logf.1" "$logf.2" }
170	                Move-Item -Force $logf "$logf.1"
171	            }
172	            $argList = @($bun.Pre + @($pkg, 'start', '--port', $port))
173	            if ((Get-CopilotPkgFlavor) -eq 'original') {
174	                $rate = if ($env:COPILOT_PROXY_RATE) { $env:COPILOT_PROXY_RATE } else { '15' }
175	                $argList += @('--rate-limit', $rate, '--wait')
176	                Write-Host "copilot-proxy: starting ($pkg) on port $port (rate-limit ${rate}s) ..."
177	            } else {
178	                Write-Host "copilot-proxy: starting ($pkg) on port $port ..."
179	            }
180	            $p = Start-Process -FilePath $bun.Exe -ArgumentList $argList -PassThru -WindowStyle Hidden `
181	                -RedirectStandardOutput $logf -RedirectStandardError "$logf.err"
182	            $p.Id | Set-Content -Path $pidf
183	            for ($i = 0; $i -lt 20; $i++) {
184	                if (Test-CopilotAlive) {
185	                    if (Get-CopilotShimEnabled) {
186	                        if (Start-CopilotShim) { Write-Host "copilot-proxy: throttle shim up -> $(Get-CopilotShimBase) (-> $(Get-CopilotBase))" }
187	                    }
188	                    Write-Host "copilot-proxy: up -> $(Get-CopilotClientBase)  (logs: copilot-proxy logs)"
189	                    return
190	                }
191	                Start-Sleep 1
192	            }
193	            Write-Error "copilot-proxy: did not come up in time — check 'copilot-proxy logs'."
194	        }
195	        'stop' {
196	            Stop-CopilotShim
197	            if (Test-Path $pidf) {
198	                $pid_ = Get-Content -First 1 $pidf -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
199	                if ($pid_) { Stop-Process -Id $pid_ -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue }
200	                Remove-Item $pidf -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
201	            }
202	            Get-CimInstance Win32_Process -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue |
203	                Where-Object { $_.CommandLine -like "*copilot-api*--port $port*" } |
204	                ForEach-Object { Stop-Process -Id $_.ProcessId -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue }
205	            Start-Sleep 1
206	            if (Test-CopilotAlive) { Write-Error "copilot-proxy: still answering on $port (another instance?)"; return }
207	            Write-Host "copilot-proxy: stopped (port $port free)"
208	        }
209	        'restart' { copilot-proxy stop; copilot-proxy start }
210	        'status' {
211	            if (Test-CopilotAlive) {
212	                Write-Host "copilot-proxy: RUNNING on $(Get-CopilotBase)"
213	                $claude = (Get-CopilotServedModels) | Where-Object { $_ -match 'claude' }
214	                Write-Host "  models: $($claude -join ' ')"
215	                if (Get-CopilotShimEnabled) {
216	                    if (Test-CopilotShimAlive) { Write-Host "  shim:   ON, up on $(Get-CopilotShimBase)  -> clients use this" }
217	                    else { Write-Host "  shim:   ON but DOWN (clients fall back to $(Get-CopilotBase))" }
218	                } else { Write-Host "  shim:   off  (enable: copilot-proxy shim on)" }
219	            } else {
220	                Write-Host "copilot-proxy: not running on port $port  (start: copilot-proxy start)"
221	            }
222	        }
223	        { $_ -in 'doctor', 'test' } { Invoke-CopilotDoctor -Live:($Argv -contains '--live') }
224	        'logs' {
225	            if ($Argv.Count -ge 2 -and $Argv[1] -eq 'shim') {
226	                $lf = Get-CopilotShimLog; $n = if ($Argv.Count -ge 3) { [int]$Argv[2] } else { 40 }
227	            } else {
228	                $lf = $logf; $n = if ($Argv.Count -ge 2) { [int]$Argv[1] } else { 40 }
229	                if ($Argv.Count -ge 3 -and $Argv[2] -in '1', '2', '3') { $lf = "$logf.$($Argv[2])" }
230	            }
231	            if (Test-Path $lf) { Get-Content -Tail $n $lf }
232	            elseif (Test-Path "$lf.err") { Get-Content -Tail $n "$lf.err" }
233	            else { Write-Error "copilot-proxy: no log file at $lf" }
234	        }
235	        'auth' {
236	            Write-Host "copilot-proxy: launching copilot-api device login ..."
237	            & $bun.Exe @($bun.Pre + @($pkg, 'auth'))
238	        }
239	        { $_ -in 'whoami', 'usage' } {
240	            if (-not (Test-Path (Get-CopilotToken))) { Write-Error "copilot-proxy: not authenticated — run 'copilot-proxy auth'."; return }
241	            if ((Get-CopilotPkgFlavor) -eq 'original') { & $bun.Exe @($bun.Pre + @($pkg, 'check-usage')) }
242	            elseif (Test-CopilotAlive) {
243	                try {
244	                    $u = Invoke-RestMethod -Uri "$(Get-CopilotBase)/usage" -TimeoutSec 5 -ErrorAction Stop
245	                    [pscustomobject]@{
246	                        plan        = if ($u.copilot_plan) { $u.copilot_plan } elseif ($u.access_type_sku) { $u.access_type_sku } else { 'unknown' }
247	                        quota_reset = $u.quota_reset_date
248	                        quotas      = $u.quota_snapshots
249	                    } | ConvertTo-Json -Depth 6
250	                } catch { Write-Error "copilot-proxy: /usage query failed: $_" }
251	            } else {
252	                Write-Host "copilot-proxy: not running — showing auth/debug info instead of quota."
253	                & $bun.Exe @($bun.Pre + @($pkg, 'debug'))
254	            }
255	        }
256	        'shim' {
257	            $sf = Get-CopilotShimState
258	            $sub = if ($Argv.Count -ge 2) { $Argv[1] } else { 'status' }
259	            switch ($sub) {
260	                'on' {
261	                    New-Item -ItemType Directory -Force -Path (Split-Path $sf) | Out-Null
262	                    'on' | Set-Content $sf
263	                    if (Test-CopilotAlive) { if (Start-CopilotShim) { Write-Host "copilot-proxy: shim ON -> $(Get-CopilotShimBase) (-> $(Get-CopilotBase))" } }
264	                    else { Write-Host "copilot-proxy: shim enabled; will start with the proxy." }
265	                    Write-Host "  NOTE: restart Claude Code so it picks up ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL=$(Get-CopilotShimBase)"
266	                }
267	                'off' {
268	                    'off' | Set-Content $sf; Stop-CopilotShim
269	                    Write-Host "copilot-proxy: shim OFF (clients use $(Get-CopilotBase) directly)"
270	                }
271	                default {
272	                    if (Get-CopilotShimEnabled) {
273	                        $st = if (Test-CopilotShimAlive) { 'up' } else { 'down' }
274	                        Write-Host "copilot-proxy: shim ON ($st) on $(Get-CopilotShimBase)"
275	                    } else { Write-Host "copilot-proxy: shim off" }
276	                }
277	            }
278	        }
279	        { $_ -in '-h', '--help', 'help' } {
280	            Write-Host "Usage: copilot-proxy [start|stop|restart|status|doctor [--live]|logs [shim|N [gen]]|shim [on|off|status]|whoami|auth]"
281	        }
282	        default { Write-Error "copilot-proxy: unknown action '$action' (try --help)" }
283	    }
284	}

286	# ------------------------------------------------------------------ doctor ----
287	function script:Invoke-CopilotDoctor {
288	    param([switch] $Live)
289	    $port = Get-CopilotPort; $pkg = Get-CopilotPkg
290	    $fail = 0; $warn = 0
291	    function OK   ($n, $m) { Write-Host ("  " + [char]0x2713 + " {0,-16} {1}" -f $n, $m) -ForegroundColor Green }
292	    function BAD  ($n, $m) { Write-Host ("  " + [char]0x2717 + " {0,-16} {1}" -f $n, $m) -ForegroundColor Red; $script:fail++ }
293	    function NOTE ($n, $m) { Write-Host ("  ! {0,-16} {1}" -f $n, $m) -ForegroundColor Yellow; $script:warn++ }
294	    function SKIP ($n, $m) { Write-Host ("  " + [char]0x00B7 + " {0,-16} {1}" -f $n, $m) }
295	    function HINT ($m)     { Write-Host ("    {0,-16} -> {1}" -f '', $m) }
296	    $script:fail = 0; $script:warn = 0
297	
298	    Write-Host "`ncopilot-proxy doctor   port $port   pkg $pkg`n"
299	
300	    Write-Host 'Prerequisites'
301	    foreach ($t in 'bun', 'node', 'uv') {
302	        $c = Get-Command $t -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
303	        if ($c) { OK $t $c.Source } elseif ($t -eq 'uv') { NOTE $t 'not found — semsearch needs it' } else { BAD $t 'not found' }
304	    }
305	
306	    Write-Host "`nAuthentication"
307	    if (Test-Path (Get-CopilotToken)) { OK 'token file' (Get-CopilotToken) } else { BAD 'token file' 'absent'; HINT 'copilot-proxy auth' }
308	
309	    Write-Host "`nProxy"
310	    if (Test-CopilotAlive) { OK 'listening' (Get-CopilotBase) } else { BAD 'listening' "nothing on port $port"; HINT 'copilot-proxy start' }
311	    if (Get-CopilotShimEnabled) {
312	        if (Test-CopilotShimAlive) { OK 'throttle shim' "up on $(Get-CopilotShimBase)" } else { BAD 'throttle shim' 'enabled but DOWN'; HINT 'copilot-proxy shim on' }
313	    } else { SKIP 'throttle shim' 'off' }
314	
315	    Write-Host "`nModels"
316	    $served = Get-CopilotServedModels
317	    if ($served -and $served.Count -gt 0) {
318	        $claude = @($served | Where-Object { $_ -match '^claude' })
319	        OK 'served' "$($served.Count) model ids"
320	        if ($claude.Count -gt 0) { OK 'claude models' "$($claude.Count) ids available" }
321	        else { BAD 'claude models' "0 of $($served.Count) — the proxy serves no Anthropic models" }
322	
323	        $pin = (Get-CopilotEffectiveModel) -split '\|', 2
324	        $model = $pin[0]; $src = $pin[1]
325	        if ($served -contains $model) { OK 'pinned model' "$model  ($src)" }
326	        else { BAD 'pinned model' "$model  ($src)"; HINT 'not served -> requests return 400 model_not_supported'; HINT 'copilot-model -l' }
327	    } else { BAD 'served' "could not fetch $(Get-CopilotBase)/v1/models" }
328	
329	    Write-Host "`nUpstream (GitHub Copilot API)"
330	    foreach ($h in 'api.enterprise.githubcopilot.com', 'api.githubcopilot.com') {
331	        try {
332	            $sw = [System.Diagnostics.Stopwatch]::StartNew()
333	            $r = Invoke-WebRequest -Uri "https://$h/models" -TimeoutSec 12 -SkipHttpErrorCheck -ErrorAction Stop
334	            $sw.Stop()
335	            OK $h "HTTP $($r.StatusCode) in $([math]::Round($sw.Elapsed.TotalSeconds,2))s"
336	        } catch { BAD $h 'no response within 12s'; HINT 'connection blocked or upstream unreachable' }
337	    }
338	    SKIP '' 'HTTP 400/401 = reached (an unauthenticated probe is expected to be rejected)'
339	
340	    Write-Host "`nLive probe"
341	    if (-not $Live) { SKIP 'skipped' 'pass --live to send one real request (consumes 1 quota unit)' }
342	    elseif (-not (Test-CopilotAlive)) { SKIP 'skipped' 'proxy is not running' }
343	    elseif (-not $served) { SKIP 'skipped' 'no served model to probe with' }
344	    else {
345	        $pm = @($served | Where-Object { $_ -notmatch 'embedding' -and $_ -notmatch '\[1m\]' })[0]
346	        $body = @{ model = $pm; max_tokens = 1; messages = @(@{ role = 'user'; content = 'hi' }) } | ConvertTo-Json -Depth 5
347	        try {
348	            $sw = [System.Diagnostics.Stopwatch]::StartNew()
349	            $r = Invoke-WebRequest -Uri "$(Get-CopilotClientBase)/v1/messages?beta=true" -Method Post `
350	                -ContentType 'application/json' -Body $body -TimeoutSec 60 -SkipHttpErrorCheck -ErrorAction Stop
351	            $sw.Stop()
352	            if ($r.StatusCode -ge 200 -and $r.StatusCode -lt 300) { OK 'round-trip' "$pm -> HTTP $($r.StatusCode) in $([math]::Round($sw.Elapsed.TotalSeconds,2))s" }
353	            else { BAD 'round-trip' "$pm -> HTTP $($r.StatusCode)"; HINT 'copilot-proxy logs 40' }
354	        } catch { BAD 'round-trip' "$pm -> request failed ($_)" }
355	    }
356	
357	    Write-Host ''
358	    if ($script:fail -gt 0) { Write-Host "$($script:fail) failed, $($script:warn) warning(s)`n"; return }
359	    Write-Host "all checks passed ($($script:warn) warning(s))`n"
360	}

362	# ------------------------------------------------------------- copilot-run ----
363	function copilot-run {
364	    [CmdletBinding()]
365	    param([Parameter(ValueFromRemainingArguments)] [string[]] $Argv)
366	    if (-not $Argv -or $Argv.Count -eq 0) { Write-Error 'Usage: copilot-run <cmd> [args...]'; return }
367	    if (-not (Test-CopilotAlive)) { copilot-proxy start; if (-not (Test-CopilotAlive)) { return } }
368	    if ((Get-CopilotShimEnabled) -and -not (Test-CopilotShimAlive)) { Start-CopilotShim | Out-Null }
369	
370	    $model = Get-CopilotDefaultModel
371	    $inject = [ordered]@{
372	        ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL             = Get-CopilotClientBase
373	        ANTHROPIC_AUTH_TOKEN           = 'dummy'
374	        ANTHROPIC_MODEL                = $model
375	        ANTHROPIC_DEFAULT_OPUS_MODEL   = $model
376	        ANTHROPIC_DEFAULT_SONNET_MODEL = 'claude-sonnet-5[1m]'
377	        ANTHROPIC_DEFAULT_HAIKU_MODEL  = 'claude-haiku-4-5'
378	        ANTHROPIC_SMALL_FAST_MODEL     = 'claude-haiku-4-5'
379	        CLAUDE_CODE_DISABLE_NONESSENTIAL_TRAFFIC = '1'
380	    }
381	    if ($env:COPILOT_PROXY_QUIET -eq '1') {
382	        $inject.CLAUDE_CODE_ATTRIBUTION_HEADER = '0'
383	        $inject.CLAUDE_CODE_ENABLE_PROMPT_SUGGESTION = 'false'
384	        $inject.CLAUDE_CODE_ENABLE_AWAY_SUMMARY = '0'
385	        $inject.DISABLE_NON_ESSENTIAL_MODEL_CALLS = '1'
386	    }
387	    # Scope env to the child process: set, run, restore (equivalent to `env VAR=..`).
388	    $saved = @{}
389	    foreach ($k in $inject.Keys) { $saved[$k] = [Environment]::GetEnvironmentVariable($k); Set-Item "env:$k" $inject[$k] }
390	    try {
391	        $exe = $Argv[0]; $rest = if ($Argv.Count -gt 1) { $Argv[1..($Argv.Count - 1)] } else { @() }
392	        & $exe @rest
393	    } finally {
394	        foreach ($k in $inject.Keys) {
395	            if ($null -eq $saved[$k]) { Remove-Item "env:$k" -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue }
396	            else { Set-Item "env:$k" $saved[$k] }
397	        }
398	    }
399	}

401	# --------------------------------------------------------- claude-copilot -----
402	function claude-copilot {
403	    [CmdletBinding()]
404	    param([Parameter(ValueFromRemainingArguments)] [string[]] $Argv)
405	    $ss = 'auto'
406	    if ($Argv -and $Argv[0] -eq '--no-specstory') { $ss = 'never'; $Argv = $Argv[1..($Argv.Count - 1)] }
407	    elseif ($Argv -and $Argv[0] -eq '--specstory') { $Argv = $Argv[1..($Argv.Count - 1)] }
408	    elseif ($Argv -and $Argv[0] -in '-h', '--help') {
409	        Write-Host "Usage: claude-copilot [--no-specstory] [claude args...]"
410	        Write-Host "  One-off Claude Code session on the Copilot proxy. Sticky: copilot-here on"
411	        Write-Host "  Runs claude with --dangerously-skip-permissions (hands-off proxy flow)."
412	        return
413	    }
414	    if ($ss -eq 'auto' -and (Get-Command specstory -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue)) {
415	        # specstory's `claude_cmd` (~/.specstory/cli/config.toml) already carries
416	        # --dangerously-skip-permissions for the no-arg path; the `-c` override
417	        # replaces claude_cmd wholesale, so re-add the flag when passing args.
418	        if ($Argv -and $Argv.Count -gt 0) { copilot-run specstory run claude -c "claude --dangerously-skip-permissions $($Argv -join ' ')" }
419	        else { copilot-run specstory run claude }
420	    } else {
421	        # No specstory on PATH (the Windows default — no native CLI yet): run claude
422	        # directly, still bypassing permission prompts so behaviour matches the
423	        # specstory path regardless of whether specstory is installed.
424	        copilot-run claude --dangerously-skip-permissions @Argv
425	    }
426	}

428	# --------------------------------------------------- claude-copilot-once ------
429	function claude-copilot-once {
430	    [CmdletBinding()]
431	    param([Parameter(ValueFromRemainingArguments)] [string[]] $Argv)
432	    if ($Argv -and $Argv[0] -in '-h', '--help') {
433	        Write-Host "Usage: claude-copilot-once [--no-specstory] [claude args...]"
434	        Write-Host "  Pin this project to the proxy, run one session, auto-unpin (even on Ctrl-C)."
435	        return
436	    }
437	    if (-not (Test-CopilotAlive)) {
438	        Write-Error "claude-copilot-once: proxy not reachable on port $(Get-CopilotPort). Start it: copilot-proxy start"; return
439	    }
440	    $wasOn = $false
441	    if (Test-Path '.claude/settings.local.json') {
442	        try { if ((Get-Content -Raw '.claude/settings.local.json' | ConvertFrom-Json).env.ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL) { $wasOn = $true } } catch { $null = $_ }
443	    }
444	    if (-not $wasOn) { copilot-here on }
445	    else { Write-Host "claude-copilot-once: copilot-here already ON here — leaving the pin in place on exit." }
446	    try {
447	        claude-copilot @Argv
448	    } finally {
449	        if (-not $wasOn) { copilot-here off }
450	        Write-Host "claude-copilot-once: session ended. Proxy still running on $(Get-CopilotBase)."
451	    }
452	}

454	# ------------------------------------------------------------ copilot-here ----
455	$script:CopilotHereKeys = @(
456	    'ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL', 'ANTHROPIC_AUTH_TOKEN', 'ANTHROPIC_MODEL', 'ANTHROPIC_DEFAULT_OPUS_MODEL',
457	    'ANTHROPIC_DEFAULT_SONNET_MODEL', 'ANTHROPIC_DEFAULT_HAIKU_MODEL', 'ANTHROPIC_SMALL_FAST_MODEL',
458	    'CLAUDE_CODE_DISABLE_NONESSENTIAL_TRAFFIC', 'CLAUDE_CODE_ATTRIBUTION_HEADER',
459	    'CLAUDE_CODE_ENABLE_PROMPT_SUGGESTION', 'CLAUDE_CODE_ENABLE_AWAY_SUMMARY', 'DISABLE_NON_ESSENTIAL_MODEL_CALLS'
460	)
461	
462	function copilot-here {
463	    [CmdletBinding()]
464	    param([Parameter(ValueFromRemainingArguments)] [string[]] $Argv)
465	    $settings = '.claude/settings.local.json'
466	    $action = if ($Argv -and $Argv.Count -ge 1) { $Argv[0] } else { 'status' }
467	    switch ($action) {
468	        'on' {
469	            New-Item -ItemType Directory -Force -Path '.claude' | Out-Null
470	            $obj = if (Test-Path $settings) { try { Get-Content -Raw $settings | ConvertFrom-Json } catch { [pscustomobject]@{} } } else { [pscustomobject]@{} }
471	            if (-not $obj.PSObject.Properties['env']) { $obj | Add-Member -NotePropertyName env -NotePropertyValue ([pscustomobject]@{}) }
472	            $model = Get-CopilotDefaultModel
473	            $envSet = [ordered]@{
474	                ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL             = Get-CopilotPinnedBase
475	                ANTHROPIC_AUTH_TOKEN           = 'dummy'
476	                ANTHROPIC_MODEL                = $model
477	                ANTHROPIC_DEFAULT_OPUS_MODEL   = $model
478	                ANTHROPIC_DEFAULT_SONNET_MODEL = 'claude-sonnet-5[1m]'
479	                ANTHROPIC_DEFAULT_HAIKU_MODEL  = 'claude-haiku-4-5'
480	                ANTHROPIC_SMALL_FAST_MODEL     = 'claude-haiku-4-5'
481	                CLAUDE_CODE_DISABLE_NONESSENTIAL_TRAFFIC = '1'
482	            }
483	            if ($env:COPILOT_PROXY_QUIET -eq '1') {
484	                $envSet.CLAUDE_CODE_ATTRIBUTION_HEADER = '0'
485	                $envSet.CLAUDE_CODE_ENABLE_PROMPT_SUGGESTION = 'false'
486	                $envSet.CLAUDE_CODE_ENABLE_AWAY_SUMMARY = '0'
487	                $envSet.DISABLE_NON_ESSENTIAL_MODEL_CALLS = '1'
488	            }
489	            foreach ($k in $envSet.Keys) {
490	                if ($obj.env.PSObject.Properties[$k]) { $obj.env.$k = $envSet[$k] }
491	                else { $obj.env | Add-Member -NotePropertyName $k -NotePropertyValue $envSet[$k] }
492	            }
493	            $obj | ConvertTo-Json -Depth 10 | Set-Content -Path $settings -Encoding utf8
494	            # Belt-and-braces gitignore via .git/info/exclude (un-anchored **/ form).
495	            $gitDir = git rev-parse --git-dir 2>$null
496	            if ($gitDir) {
497	                git check-ignore -q $settings 2>$null
498	                if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) {
499	                    $exclude = Join-Path $gitDir 'info/exclude'
500	                    Add-Content -Path $exclude -Value '**/.claude/settings.local.json'
501	                }
502	            }

    feat(copilot-proxy): detect wedged bun installer in doctor + log pitfall
    
    `copilot-proxy start` could hang forever with only "did not come up in time"
    and a log containing just "Resolving dependencies". Root cause: bunx must
    `bun add` the pinned copilot-api before `start` can bind the port, and bun
    stalls resolving through the socks ALL_PROXY (Clash/mihomo) — even though curl
    reaches the same npmmirror registry in <0.4s either way. The wedged installer
    keeps bun's global cache lock, so every retry hangs identically and stacks
    another zombie pair; `start`'s 20s timeout never kills what it spawned.
    
    - `_copilot_stale_installers`: pgrep for live `bun add … copilot-api`, which is
      never normal once the one-shot install is done.
    - doctor Proxy section: red when nothing is listening (that IS the fault),
      yellow when the proxy is up (leftover still holding the cache lock, will hang
      the next restart), with the clear-and-restart one-liner and the
      strip-the-proxy-env retry.
    - docs (en + zh-TW): new stale-installer subsection; check order updated.
    - pitfalls/: symptom-grep entry — clearing the lock alone is NOT durable, the
      stall recurs on the next cold resolve; stripping ALL_PROXY/HTTPS_PROXY is what
      actually sticks (verified: 99 pkgs resolved, port bound in 3s).
    
    Verified: bash/zsh -n; doctor exercised on all three paths (up / up+leftover /
    down+wedged); bats tests/unit/copilot_proxy.bats 10/10.

diff --git a/dot_config/shell/43_copilot_proxy.sh b/dot_config/shell/43_copilot_proxy.sh
index 9d2b02e..9c8e4d4 100644
--- a/dot_config/shell/43_copilot_proxy.sh
+++ b/dot_config/shell/43_copilot_proxy.sh
@@ -292,6 +292,21 @@ _copilot_system_proxy() {
     END { if (en == 1 && h != "" && p != "") printf "%s:%s", h, p }'
 }
 
+# PIDs of bun package-installer processes still resolving copilot-api, one per
+# line (empty when none). bunx must `bun add` the pinned package into a temp dir
+# before `start` can bind the port; when that resolve hangs — typically bun
+# stalling against the npm registry through a socks ALL_PROXY, even when curl to
+# the same registry is fine — `copilot-proxy start` blocks at "Resolving
+# dependencies", times out after ~20s, and leaves the installer wedged. Worse,
+# it keeps bun's global install-cache lock, so the NEXT start hangs the same way
+# and retries just pile up more zombies. A live `bun add … copilot-api` is never
+# normal once install is done (it's a one-shot), so a match is a clean
+# stale-installer signal. Pattern matches both flavors' package names. Verified
+# 2026-07: three stacked zombies from three retries, none ever bound the port.
+_copilot_stale_installers() {
+  command pgrep -f 'bun add.*copilot-api' 2>/dev/null
+}
+
 # --- proxy manager --------------------------------------------------------------
 
 # Manage the copilot-api proxy. Subcommands: start|stop|status|restart|logs|auth.
@@ -456,6 +471,26 @@ copilot-proxy() {
         _bad "listening" "nothing answering on port $port"
         _hint "copilot-proxy start"
       fi
+      # A wedged package installer is the non-obvious reason a proxy never binds
+      # the port (see _copilot_stale_installers): 'copilot-proxy start' just says
+      # "did not come up in time" and the log shows only "Resolving dependencies".
+      # Flag it hard when nothing is listening (this IS the fault), softer when
+      # the proxy is up (a leftover, but still worth clearing — it holds bun's
+      # cache lock and will hang the next restart).
+      local _stale _stale_n
+      _stale="$(_copilot_stale_installers)"
+      if [ -n "$_stale" ]; then
+        _stale_n="$(printf '%s\n' "$_stale" | command grep -c .)"
+        if _copilot_alive; then
+          _note "stale installer" "$_stale_n leftover 'bun add … copilot-api' proc(s) — harmless now, but they hold bun's cache lock (a restart will hang)"
+        else
+          _bad "stale installer" "$_stale_n wedged 'bun add … copilot-api' proc(s) — start is blocked at \"Resolving dependencies\", never binds port $port"
+        fi
+        _hint "pkill -f 'bun add.*copilot-api'; rm -rf \"\$HOME/.bun/install/cache/.tmp\"/*; copilot-proxy start"
+        _hint "re-hangs? bun is stalling on the socks proxy — env -u ALL_PROXY -u HTTPS_PROXY -u HTTP_PROXY copilot-proxy start"
+      else
+        _skip "installer" "no wedged 'bun add' process"
+      fi
       if _copilot_shim_enabled; then
         if _copilot_shim_alive; then _ok "throttle shim" "up on $(_copilot_shim_base) → clients use this"
         else _bad "throttle shim" "enabled but DOWN"; _hint "copilot-proxy shim on"; fi

```text
c6e0a8b fix(copilot-proxy): install the pinned package once, stop resolving at launch

 docs/tools/copilot-claude-proxy.md                 |  89 +++++++--
 docs/tools/copilot-claude-proxy.zh-TW.md           |  71 +++++--
 dot_config/shell/43_copilot_proxy.sh               | 218 ++++++++++++++++++---
 pitfalls/README.md                                 |   2 +-
 ...-proxy-start-hangs-at-resolving-dependencies.md |  26 ++-

 6 files changed, 398 insertions(+), 65 deletions(-)
=========== DIFF ===========
commit c6e0a8b1fd77e3d8b404553aa572792af74fbde3
Author: Da-Wei Lee <daviddwlee84@gmail.com>
Date:   Mon Jul 13 01:55:10 2026 +0800

    fix(copilot-proxy): install the pinned package once, stop resolving at launch
    
    `copilot-proxy start` ran `bunx <pkg> start`, and bunx re-resolves the package on
    every launch. bun stalls indefinitely resolving through a socks ALL_PROXY (curl
    through the same proxy reaches npmmirror in <0.4s, which is what made this so
    misleading), so start hung at "Resolving dependencies" and never bound the port.
    Two amplifiers turned one stall into a permanent wedge: the stalled `bun add`
    kept bun's global install-cache lock, so the next start hung on the lock too; and
    start's 20s timeout returned WITHOUT killing what it spawned, so every retry left
    another orphan — five of them, in the wild, none listening.
    
    Remove the per-launch resolve entirely rather than making it likelier to succeed:
    
    - `_copilot_ensure_pkg` installs the pinned spec once into
      $XDG_DATA_HOME/copilot-api/pkg, stamped with the spec (a version bump
      re-installs). `start` then execs node_modules/.bin/copilot-api directly — a warm
      start does zero network before binding. Also used by auth/whoami, which would
      otherwise hit the same hang on a fresh machine.
    - `_copilot_pkg_install_try` bounds each attempt and kills it on timeout, so a
      stalled installer can never again hold the cache lock. Attempt 1 honours the
      ambient env (a host may only reach the registry THROUGH the proxy); attempt 2
      strips it. COPILOT_INSTALL_NOPROXY=1 skips to attempt 2.
    - `start` reaps the server it spawned on timeout, and bails early if it dies.
    - doctor: `bun` prereq (bunx is no longer used) + a Package section showing the
      installed spec and binary. New `copilot-proxy reinstall` for a corrupted prefix.
    - pitfall flipped to fixed; docs (en + zh-TW) get the post-mortem gotcha.
    
    `_copilot_pkg_name` keeps the @scope while stripping the version — the naive
    "${spec%@*}" empties a scoped spec with no version, which would have degraded the
    reap pattern to `bun add.*`, matching every bun install on the box. Covered by tests.
    
    Verified: bash/zsh -n; shellcheck; bats 15/15 (5 new); cold start installs+binds
    in 5s; warm start binds in 4s WITH the socks env set (the old killer) and never
    touches the network; forced stall (uncached pkg + blackhole proxy) returns 124 in
    exactly the budget with zero surviving bun processes; restart/status/doctor clean;
    mkdocs --strict unchanged at the pre-existing 163-warning baseline.
    
    Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 4.8 (1M context) <noreply@anthropic.com>

diff --git a/dot_config/shell/43_copilot_proxy.sh b/dot_config/shell/43_copilot_proxy.sh
index 9c8e4d4..264dc8c 100644
--- a/dot_config/shell/43_copilot_proxy.sh
+++ b/dot_config/shell/43_copilot_proxy.sh
@@ -43,15 +43,22 @@
 #     `copilot-here on` points elsewhere (run `copilot-here off` first).
 #
 # Portability notes (POSIX subset, both shells source this file):
-#   - runs the proxy via `bunx` (matches 07_bunx_cli.sh); pinned version avoids a
-#     per-launch @latest registry round-trip. Override with COPILOT_API_PKG.
+#   - the pinned package is INSTALLED ONCE into _copilot_pkg_prefix and the proxy
+#     runs that binary directly. It deliberately does NOT use `bunx` at launch:
+#     bunx re-resolves the package on every start, and bun stalls forever
+#     resolving through a socks ALL_PROXY — which wedged `start` at "Resolving
+#     dependencies" AND kept bun's global cache lock, so every retry hung too.
+#     See pitfalls/copilot-proxy-start-hangs-at-resolving-dependencies.md.
+#     Override the spec with COPILOT_API_PKG; force a re-install with
+#     `copilot-proxy reinstall`.
 #   - no ZLE/compdef/setopt/glob-qualifiers here (bash would error on source).
 #
 # Env (set in ~/.shellrc.adhoc or ~/.config/{zsh/secrets.zsh,bash/secrets.sh}):
 #   COPILOT_PROXY_PORT   default: 4141        - port the proxy listens on
 #   COPILOT_API_PKG      default: @jeffreycao/copilot-api@1.13.14
-#                                             - bunx package spec (pin/upgrade;
-#                                               copilot-api@0.7.0 = old original)
+#                                             - package spec to install (pin/
+#                                               upgrade; copilot-api@0.7.0 = old
+#                                               original). Changing it re-installs.
 #   COPILOT_PROXY_RATE   default: 15          - --rate-limit seconds; ONLY used
 #                                               by the original package (the fork
 #                                               has no rate limiter)
@@ -78,6 +85,125 @@ _copilot_base() { printf 'http://localhost:%s' "$(_copilot_port)"; }
 _copilot_logfile() { printf '%s' "${TMPDIR:-/tmp}/copilot-api-$(_copilot_port).log"; }
 _copilot_pidfile() { printf '%s' "${TMPDIR:-/tmp}/copilot-api-$(_copilot_port).pid"; }
 
+# --- pinned package install (run the binary, never `bunx` at launch) -------------
+#
+# Why an install prefix instead of `bunx <pkg> start`: bunx re-resolves the
+# package on EVERY launch, and bun hangs indefinitely resolving through a socks
+# ALL_PROXY (curl through the same proxy is fine, which is what makes it so
+# confusing). The wedged installer then keeps bun's global cache lock, so every
+# retry hangs identically and stacks another zombie. Installing once and exec'ing
+# the resulting binary removes the per-start resolve entirely — a warm start does
+# zero network before it binds the port. Full story:
+# pitfalls/copilot-proxy-start-hangs-at-resolving-dependencies.md
+
+# Package NAME without the trailing @version, keeping any @scope/ prefix.
+# The naive "${spec%@*}" eats the whole string on a scoped spec with no version
+# (@jeffreycao/copilot-api -> ""), so test on the scope-stripped copy.
+_copilot_pkg_name() {
+  local spec base
+  spec="$(_copilot_pkg)"
+  base="${spec#@}"
+  case "$base" in
+    *@*) printf '%s' "${spec%@*}" ;;
+    *)   printf '%s' "$spec" ;;
+  esac
+}
+
+_copilot_pkg_prefix() { printf '%s' "${XDG_DATA_HOME:-$HOME/.local/share}/copilot-api/pkg"; }
+_copilot_pkg_bin()    { printf '%s' "$(_copilot_pkg_prefix)/node_modules/.bin/copilot-api"; }
+# Records the spec the prefix currently holds, so bumping COPILOT_API_PKG (or the
+# pinned default) re-installs instead of silently running the old version.
+_copilot_pkg_stamp()  { printf '%s' "$(_copilot_pkg_prefix)/.installed-spec"; }
+
+# Is the CURRENTLY pinned spec installed and runnable?
+_copilot_pkg_ready() {
+  local bin stamp
+  bin="$(_copilot_pkg_bin)"; stamp="$(_copilot_pkg_stamp)"
+  [ -x "$bin" ] || return 1
+  [ -f "$stamp" ] || return 1
+  [ "$(command head -n 1 "$stamp" 2>/dev/null)" = "$(_copilot_pkg)" ]
+}
+
+# One `bun add` attempt in $1. $2 = "noproxy" strips the proxy env, anything else
+# honours it. $3 = seconds budget, enforced by polling — `timeout(1)` is not in
+# macOS base, and this file is sourced by both shells. Returns 124 on expiry.
+#
+# The kill on expiry is the load-bearing part: a stalled `bun add` left running
+# keeps bun's global install-cache lock, and THAT is what made every subsequent
+# start hang too. Never let one escape.
+_copilot_pkg_install_try() {
+  local dir="$1" mode="$2" budget="$3" pkg pid i=0
+  pkg="$(_copilot_pkg)"
+  if [ "$mode" = "noproxy" ]; then
+    ( cd "$dir" 2>/dev/null && command env \
+        -u ALL_PROXY -u all_proxy -u HTTP_PROXY -u http_proxy \
+        -u HTTPS_PROXY -u https_proxy \
+        bun add "$pkg" --no-summary >/dev/null 2>&1 ) &
+  else

+  fi
+  pid=$!
+  while [ "$i" -lt "$budget" ]; do

+      wait "$pid" 2>/dev/null

+    fi

+  # we report the timeout ourselves, and a raw job-control message here reads like
+  # a crash. Kill the whole process group's `bun add` too — the subshell's child
+  # is the one actually holding the cache lock.

+    command pkill -9 -f "bun add.*$(_copilot_pkg_name)" 2>/dev/null

+      return 1
+    fi
+  fi
+
+  if [ ! -x "$bin" ]; then
+    printf '%s\n' "copilot-proxy: install finished but $bin is missing." >&2
+    return 1
+  fi
+  printf '%s\n' "$spec" >"$(_copilot_pkg_stamp)"

```text
47014a7 fix(copilot-proxy): keep claude_cmd flags when args go through specstory
specstory's `-c/--command` REPLACES the provider command instead of
appending to it — it is the same slot as `claude_cmd`, last write wins, as
the shipped config's own comment states. The hardcoded `-c "claude $*"`
therefore dropped every configured flag the moment claude-copilot had args
to pass through, so these two silently disagreed:

  claude-copilot-once             -> bypass-permissions  (no -c branch)
  claude-copilot-once --resume X  -> ~/.claude defaultMode "auto"

Rebuild the -c string from the effective `claude_cmd` (project
./.specstory/cli/config.toml > user ~/.specstory/cli/config.toml > bare
`claude`) so the specstory config stays the single source of truth for both
branches. `--no-specstory` deliberately does not inherit it.

The resolver matches uncommented assignments only: both shipped configs
carry a commented `# claude_cmd = "claude"` example, and matching it would
re-introduce the very bug this fixes.

Also quote each passthrough arg — specstory shell-splits the -c string
honouring quotes, so the old `$*` flattened `-p "two words"` into two
separate arguments.

Verified against specstory 2.5.0 with a fake agent logging its own argv;
helpers exercised in both bash and zsh (shared POSIX tier).

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5 (1M context) <noreply@anthropic.com>

+# --- specstory `-c` passthrough (why the base command must come from config) ----
+#
+# specstory's `-c/--command` REPLACES the provider's configured command — it does
+# NOT append to it. The shipped config says as much: "Use of these is equivalent
+# to -c \"custom command\"" — same slot, last write wins. So a hardcoded
+# `-c "claude $*"` silently drops every flag in `claude_cmd` the moment
+# claude-copilot has args to pass through.
+#
+# Symptom that found this (verified 2026-07, specstory 2.5.0): with
+# `claude_cmd = "claude --dangerously-skip-permissions"` in the specstory config,
+# a bare `claude-copilot-once` took the no-`-c` branch and correctly ran in
+# bypass-permissions mode, but `claude-copilot-once --resume X` took the `-c`
+# branch and fell back to ~/.claude/settings.json's permissions.defaultMode
+# ("auto"). Same wrapper, opposite permission mode, no warning either way.
+#
+# Deriving the base command from the config keeps specstory the single source of
+# truth for BOTH branches: change `claude_cmd` there and both paths follow.
+# `--no-specstory` deliberately does NOT inherit it (opting out of specstory
+# means opting out of its config too).
+
+# Effective `claude_cmd`, honouring specstory's own precedence:
+#   project ./.specstory/cli/config.toml > user ~/.specstory/cli/config.toml
+#   > bare `claude`
+# Matches UNCOMMENTED assignments only — both shipped configs carry a commented
+# `# claude_cmd = "claude"` example, and matching that would re-introduce the very
+# bug this exists to fix. Handles TOML's double- and single-quoted strings.
+_copilot_specstory_claude_cmd() {
+  local f cmd=''
+  for f in ".specstory/cli/config.toml" "$HOME/.specstory/cli/config.toml"; do
+    [ -f "$f" ] || continue
+    cmd="$(command sed -n \
+      -e "s/^[[:space:]]*claude_cmd[[:space:]]*=[[:space:]]*\"\([^\"]*\)\".*/\1/p" \
+      -e "s/^[[:space:]]*claude_cmd[[:space:]]*=[[:space:]]*'\([^']*\)'.*/\1/p" \
+      "$f" 2>/dev/null | command head -n 1)"

+  done
+  printf '%s' "${cmd:-claude}"

+# Single-quote ONE argument for embedding in specstory's `-c` command STRING.
+# specstory shell-splits that string honouring quotes (verified: `-p 'a b'`

+# the old `"claude $*"` flattened `claude-copilot -p "two words"` into two
+# separate arguments. POSIX escape for an embedded quote: close, \', reopen.
+_copilot_shquote() {
+  printf "'%s'" "$(printf '%s' "${1:-}" | command sed "s/'/'\\\\''/g")"
+}

+      # unquoted so specstory splits them normally) + each of our args quoted.
+      local _cc_cmd _cc_arg
+      _cc_cmd="$(_copilot_specstory_claude_cmd)"
+      for _cc_arg in "$@"; do
+        _cc_cmd="$_cc_cmd $(_copilot_shquote "$_cc_arg")"
+      done
+      copilot-run specstory run claude -c "$_cc_cmd"
     else
       copilot-run specstory run claude
     fi

0b91e3b fix(copilot-proxy): drift check compared 4 of the 8 keys `copilot-here on` writes
`copilot-here on` merged an 8-key env block (12 with COPILOT_PROXY_QUIET=1)
while _copilot_here_drift hand-compared only ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL,
ANTHROPIC_MODEL, ANTHROPIC_DEFAULT_OPUS_MODEL and
ANTHROPIC_DEFAULT_SONNET_MODEL. Two hand-maintained copies of the same block,
already diverged: a pin written by an older `on` — current models but no
ANTHROPIC_DEFAULT_HAIKU_MODEL / ANTHROPIC_SMALL_FAST_MODEL /
CLAUDE_CODE_DISABLE_NONESSENTIAL_TRAFFIC — reported "no drift", so
claude-copilot-once never offered to refresh it even though `on` would have
changed the file.

Extract _copilot_env_json as the single source of truth. `copilot-here on`
merges it; the drift check diffs the live file against it. Drift is now
exactly "the set of keys `on` would change", so a key can no longer be added
to one side and forgotten on the other.

The asymmetry is deliberate and documented: keys in the file but not in the
want-set are not drift, because `on` merges and never removes (only `off`
does) — so leftover QUIET extras don't nag after COPILOT_PROXY_QUIET goes
back to 0.

Verified: stale-pin detection unchanged (same 3 keys); the previously
invisible partial pin now reports its 3 missing keys; `on` output is
byte-identical to the old implementation (diffed against a pin the old code
wrote); refresh is a fixpoint (drift clears after `on`); on/off round trip
still removes the file.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5 (1M context) <noreply@anthropic.com>

```text
1	# copilot-proxy
2	
3	A native PowerShell port of the `copilot-proxy` tool series: it runs the
4	[copilot-api](https://github.com/caozhiyuan/copilot-api) fork so a **GitHub Copilot
5	subscription** can back **Claude Code** (and any Anthropic/OpenAI-compatible client).
6	
7	Shipped as a module at `~/.config/powershell/modules/Copilot`, auto-imported by the
8	`$PROFILE`. Requires `bun` (installed via mise) and a Copilot subscription.
9	
10	## Commands
11	
12	| Command | What it does |
13	|---|---|
14	| `copilot-proxy auth` | one-time GitHub device login (stores a token) |
15	| `copilot-proxy start` / `stop` / `restart` | manage the local proxy (port 4141) |
16	| `copilot-proxy status` | is it up? which models? |
17	| `copilot-proxy doctor [--live]` | diagnose prereqs → auth → proxy → model entitlement → upstream |
18	| `copilot-proxy logs [N]` | tail the proxy log |
19	| `copilot-proxy shim [on\|off]` | toggle the throttle shim (port 4142) |
20	| `copilot-proxy whoami` | account / plan / quota |
21	| `copilot-run <cmd...>` | run a command with the proxy env injected |
22	| `claude-copilot` | one-off Claude Code session on the proxy |
23	| `claude-copilot-once` | pin this project, run once, auto-unpin (even on Ctrl-C) |
24	| `copilot-here [on\|off\|status]` | sticky per-project pin via `.claude/settings.local.json` |
25	| `copilot-model [<id>\|-l\|-c]` | switch the pinned model |
26	| `copilot-embed [TEXT\|-]` | embed text via the proxy's `/v1/embeddings` |
27	| `semsearch index \| <QUERY>` | semantic search over local text |
28	
29	## Quick start
30	
31	```powershell
32	copilot-proxy auth        # once
33	copilot-proxy start
34	copilot-proxy doctor      # verify the whole path
35	claude-copilot            # a Claude Code session backed by Copilot
36	```
37	
38	## Notes
39	
40	- **Default model** is `claude-opus-4-8[1m]`. The `[1m]` suffix is a Claude Code
41	  hint for the 1M-context window; it's stripped before validating against the proxy.
42	- **`copilot-here`** writes only the gitignored `.claude/settings.local.json`, never
43	  the committed `.claude/settings.json`, and adds a `.git/info/exclude` entry so the
44	  pin never lands in a commit.
45	- **`claude-copilot` / `claude-copilot-once`** run Claude Code with
46	  `--dangerously-skip-permissions` — the proxy path is the trusted, hands-off flow,
47	  so it never stops for permission prompts (plain `claude` is unaffected; the global
48	  default stays `auto`). When the SpecStory CLI is on `PATH` they also wrap the
49	  session in `specstory run` for auto-saved transcripts; on Windows that CLI has no
50	  official release, so it's opt-in via the **SpecStory build** init prompt.
51	- **The throttle shim** (`copilot-throttle-shim.js`, run under Bun) caps concurrent
52	  in-flight requests and transparently retries 403/429 bursts — it's the same JS used
53	  on macOS/Linux, unchanged.
54	- State lives under `~/.local/state/copilot-proxy/`; the token under
55	  `~/.local/share/copilot-api/github_token`.
56	
57	!!! warning "Entitlement"
58	    Some Copilot plans serve no Anthropic models — every request then returns
59	    `400 model_not_supported`. `copilot-proxy doctor` distinguishes that
60	    account-policy case from a stale model cache.
61

366	_copilot_probe() {
367	  local url="$1" via="${2:-}" out
368	  if [ -n "$via" ]; then
369	    out="$(command curl -o /dev/null -s -w '%{http_code}|%{time_total}' --max-time 12 -x "$via" "$url" 2>/dev/null)" || return 1
370	  else
371	    out="$(command curl -o /dev/null -s -w '%{http_code}|%{time_total}' --max-time 12 --noproxy '*' "$url" 2>/dev/null)" || return 1
372	  fi

377	# Model ids GitHub serves for this account RIGHT NOW.
378	#
379	# Why this exists: copilot-api fetches /models ONCE at startup and caches it for
380	# the whole process lifetime. A degraded OR geo-filtered startup fetch leaves
381	# the proxy serving a truncated list forever, and every request for a missing
382	# model returns a 400 "model_not_supported" that looks exactly like an
383	# entitlement problem. Comparing live-upstream against proxy-cached is the only
384	# way to tell those apart. Verified 2026-07.
385	#
386	# $1 selects the egress path for the curl probe (curl follows the macOS system
387	# proxy by default — which is exactly what made the old doctor mis-diagnose
388	# "entitlement" when System Proxy was ON but Node was going direct):
389	#   (empty)           — curl defaults (may use System Proxy on macOS)
390	#   direct            — --noproxy '*' (true direct egress)
391	#   http://host:port  — force -x that proxy
392	#
393	# Secrets: the ghu_/bearer tokens are passed via `curl -K -` (stdin config), NOT
394	# argv — argv is world-readable via `ps`. Never echo either token.
395	_copilot_upstream_models() {
396	  local via="${1:-}"
397	  local tokfile="$HOME/.local/share/copilot-api/github_token"
398	  [ -f "$tokfile" ] || return 1

400	
401	  local ghu ex api ctok up

405	  # Transport: keep as one argv word so zsh doesn't glob `*`.

414	  # bash arrays work when this file is sourced from bash; zsh too. Avoid
415	  # unquoted $* expansion of `--noproxy *`.

460	       && [ -n "${_NET_PROXY_CACHE:-}" ] \
461	       && [ "$_NET_PROXY_CACHE" != "none" ]; then
462	      printf '%s' "$_NET_PROXY_CACHE"
463	      return 0
464	    fi
465	  fi
466	
467	  # Fallback when 50_networking.sh isn't sourced yet (rare; file order is 43→50).
468	  local sys
469	  sys="$(_copilot_system_proxy)"
470	  if [ -n "$sys" ]; then
471	    printf '%s' "http://$sys"
472	    return 0
473	  fi
474	  return 0
475	}
476	
477	# Normalise a model id for cross-source comparison: lowercase, dots -> dashes
478	# (upstream says claude-opus-4.8, the proxy says claude-opus-4-8), drop the
479	# Claude Code-only "[1m]" suffix. Reads ids on stdin, one per line.
480	_copilot_norm_models() {
481	  command tr 'A-Z' 'a-z' | command sed 's/\[1m\]$//; s/\./-/g' | command sort -u
482	}
483	
484	# macOS system HTTP proxy as "host:port", empty when disabled/not macOS.
485	_copilot_system_proxy() {
486	  command -v scutil >/dev/null 2>&1 || return 0
487	  command scutil --proxy 2>/dev/null | command awk '
488	    /HTTPEnable/ { en=$3 } /HTTPProxy/ { h=$3 } /HTTPPort/ { p=$3 }
489	    END { if (en == 1 && h != "" && p != "") printf "%s:%s", h, p }'
490	}
491	
492	# PIDs of bun package-installer processes still resolving copilot-api, one per
493	# line (empty when none). bun stalls indefinitely resolving through a socks
494	# ALL_PROXY (even when curl to the same registry is fine), and a stalled
495	# `bun add` keeps bun's global install-cache lock — which wedges every later
496	# install too. _copilot_pkg_install_try now bounds and kills its own attempts, so
497	# this should stay empty; it remains as a safety net for a stall we didn't spawn
498	# (a hand-run `bunx @jeffreycao/copilot-api`, or a zombie left by the pre-install
499	# design that resolved on every launch). A live `bun add … copilot-api` is never
500	# normal at rest — install is a one-shot — so a match is a clean signal.
501	# Verified 2026-07: five stacked zombies from five retries, none ever bound the port.
502	_copilot_stale_installers() {
503	  command pgrep -f 'bun add.*copilot-api' 2>/dev/null
504	}
505	
506	# --- proxy manager --------------------------------------------------------------
507	
508	# Manage the copilot-api proxy. Subcommands: start|stop|status|restart|logs|auth.
509	# Example:
510	#   copilot-proxy start          # background-start on $COPILOT_PROXY_PORT
511	#   copilot-proxy status         # is it up? which models?
512	copilot-proxy() {
513	  if [ -n "$ZSH_VERSION" ]; then
514	    emulate -L zsh
515	    setopt localoptions pipefail
516	  else
517	    set -o pipefail
518	  fi
519
```
</details></tool-use>

```text
1	# copilot-proxy
2	
3	`copilot-proxy` 工具系列的原生 PowerShell 版本：它執行
4	[copilot-api](https://github.com/caozhiyuan/copilot-api) fork，讓 **GitHub Copilot
5	訂閱**可以當作 **Claude Code**（以及任何 Anthropic/OpenAI 相容 client）的後端。
6	
7	以模組形式放在 `~/.config/powershell/modules/Copilot`，由 `$PROFILE` 自動匯入。
8	需要 `bun`（由 mise 安裝）與 Copilot 訂閱。
9	
10	## 指令
11	
12	| 指令 | 作用 |
13	|---|---|
14	| `copilot-proxy auth` | 一次性的 GitHub device 登入（儲存 token） |
15	| `copilot-proxy start` / `stop` / `restart` | 管理本機 proxy（port 4141） |
16	| `copilot-proxy status` | 是否啟動？有哪些模型？ |
17	| `copilot-proxy doctor [--live]` | 診斷前置需求 → 認證 → proxy → 模型權限 → 上游 |
18	| `copilot-proxy logs [N]` | 查看 proxy log |
19	| `copilot-proxy shim [on\|off]` | 切換節流 shim（port 4142） |
20	| `copilot-proxy whoami` | 帳號 / 方案 / 額度 |
21	| `copilot-run <cmd...>` | 帶著 proxy 環境變數執行指令 |
22	| `claude-copilot` | 在 proxy 上開一次性的 Claude Code session |
23	| `claude-copilot-once` | 釘住此專案、跑一次、自動取消釘選（連 Ctrl-C 也是） |
24	| `copilot-here [on\|off\|status]` | 用 `.claude/settings.local.json` 做專案層級的釘選 |
25	| `copilot-model [<id>\|-l\|-c]` | 切換釘選的模型 |
26	| `copilot-embed [TEXT\|-]` | 透過 proxy 的 `/v1/embeddings` 產生向量 |
27	| `semsearch index \| <QUERY>` | 對本機文字做語意搜尋 |
28	
29	## 快速開始
30	
31	```powershell
32	copilot-proxy auth        # 只需一次
33	copilot-proxy start
34	copilot-proxy doctor      # 驗證整條路徑
35	claude-copilot            # 以 Copilot 為後端的 Claude Code session
36	```
37	
38	## 備註
39	
40	- **預設模型**是 `claude-opus-4-8[1m]`。`[1m]` 後綴是給 Claude Code 的 1M context
41	  提示；在對 proxy 驗證前會被去掉。
42	- **`copilot-here`** 只寫入被 gitignore 的 `.claude/settings.local.json`，絕不動到
43	  已提交的 `.claude/settings.json`，並加一筆 `.git/info/exclude`，讓釘選永遠不會被
44	  commit 進去。
45	- **`claude-copilot` / `claude-copilot-once`** 會以 `--dangerously-skip-permissions`
46	  執行 Claude Code —— proxy 這條是可信、免確認的流程，不會停下來問權限（純 `claude`
47	  不受影響；全域預設仍為 `auto`）。當 SpecStory CLI 在 `PATH` 上時，也會用
48	  `specstory run` 包住 session 以自動存檔逐字稿；Windows 上該 CLI 沒有官方 release，
49	  需透過 **SpecStory build** 初始化提問選用啟用。
50	- **節流 shim**（`copilot-throttle-shim.js`，以 Bun 執行）限制同時在途的請求數，
51	  並在 403/429 爆量時透明重試 —— 與 macOS/Linux 用的是同一份 JS，未經修改。
52	- 狀態放在 `~/.local/state/copilot-proxy/`；token 放在
53	  `~/.local/share/copilot-api/github_token`。
54	
55	!!! warning "權限（entitlement）"
56	    有些 Copilot 方案不提供任何 Anthropic 模型 —— 這時每個請求都會回
57	    `400 model_not_supported`。`copilot-proxy doctor` 能區分這種帳號政策問題與
58	    模型快取過期。
59
```
</details></tool-use>

## copilot-proxy
- Module at `~/.config/powershell/modules/Copilot`. Commands: `copilot-proxy`
  (`start`/`stop`/`restart`/`status`/`doctor`/`logs`/`shim`/`whoami`/`auth`),
  `copilot-run`, `claude-copilot`, `claude-copilot-once`, `copilot-here`,
  `copilot-model`, `copilot-embed`, `semsearch`.
- Needs `bun`. Token: `~/.local/share/copilot-api/github_token`. Ports 4141 (proxy) /
  4142 (throttle shim). Default model `claude-opus-4-8[1m]`. `copilot-here` writes
  only the gitignored `./.claude/settings.local.json`. Full guide: `docs/copilot-proxy.md`.

## Editors / terminal / tv
- VSCode & Cursor settings + keybindings are deep-merged into `%APPDATA%\{Code,Cursor}\User`
  by `.chezmoiscripts/run_onchange_after_20_editor_overlays.ps1.tmpl` (sources under `editors/`).
- Windows Terminal `profiles.defaults`, Alacritty (`%APPDATA%\alacritty\alacritty.toml`),
  and WezTerm (`~/.config/wezterm/wezterm.lua`, pwsh as default shell) are managed too.
  Television channels live under `%APPDATA%\television\cable\` (`tv <name>`).

+#   COPILOT_SHIM_PORT    default 4142    - throttle shim port
+#   COPILOT_API_PKG      default @jeffreycao/copilot-api@1.13.14 - spec to install
+#                                          (changing it re-installs via the stamp)
+#   COPILOT_CLAUDE_MODEL                 - override the pinned model
+#   COPILOT_PROXY_QUIET  1               - add the telemetry-suppressing env keys
+#   COPILOT_INSTALL_NOPROXY 1            - skip straight to the no-proxy install try

 function script:Get-XdgState { if ($env:XDG_STATE_HOME) { $env:XDG_STATE_HOME } else { Join-Path $HOME '.local/state' } }

+function script:Get-XdgData { if ($env:XDG_DATA_HOME) { $env:XDG_DATA_HOME } else { Join-Path $HOME '.local/share' } }
+
+# --- pinned package install (run the binary, never `bunx` at launch) -----------
+#
+# Why an install prefix instead of `bunx <pkg> start`: bunx re-resolves the
+# package on EVERY launch, and bun hangs indefinitely resolving through a socks
+# proxy (a browser/curl through the same proxy is fine, which is what makes it so
+# confusing). The wedged installer then keeps bun's global install-cache lock, so
+# every retry hangs identically and stacks another zombie. Installing once and
+# running the resulting binary removes the per-start resolve entirely — a warm
+# start does zero network before it binds the port.

+function script:Get-CopilotPkgName {
+    $spec = Get-CopilotPkg
+    if ($spec.TrimStart('@') -match '@') { $spec -replace '@[^@]*$', '' } else { $spec }

+

+# Returns $null when no directly-runnable shim exists — Get-CopilotPkgLaunch then
+# falls back to `bun run`, which resolves from the local node_modules offline.
+function script:Get-CopilotPkgBin {
+    $binDir = Join-Path (Get-CopilotPkgPrefix) 'node_modules/.bin'
+    foreach ($ext in '.exe', '.cmd', '.bat', '', '.ps1') {
+        $p = Join-Path $binDir "copilot-api$ext"
+        if (Test-Path -LiteralPath $p -PathType Leaf) { return $p }
+    }
+    $null

+# the `bun run` fallback, which must resolve node_modules/.bin from the prefix.
+#

+# under a $HOME containing a space ("C:\Users\Da-Wei Lee\...") would arrive split
+# across two argv entries. -WorkingDirectory takes the path as a real parameter.

+    $bin = Get-CopilotPkgBin
+    # .ps1 can't be Start-Process'd directly, and a bare extensionless shim is a
+    # shell script — route both through `bun run`, which finds node_modules/.bin.
+    if ($bin -and [System.IO.Path]::GetExtension($bin) -in '.exe', '.cmd', '.bat') {
+        return @{ Exe = $bin; Pre = @(); Cwd = $null }
+    }
+    if (Get-Command bun -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue) {
+        return @{ Exe = 'bun'; Pre = @('run', 'copilot-api'); Cwd = (Get-CopilotPkgPrefix) }
+    }

+# process exit code is not trusted.

+    Test-Path -LiteralPath (Join-Path (Get-CopilotPkgPrefix) "node_modules/$(Get-CopilotPkgName)")

+# Ensure the pinned spec is installed. No-op (and no network) once it is.
+function script:Install-CopilotPkg {
+    if (Test-CopilotPkgReady) { return $true }

+        Write-Error "copilot-proxy: bun not found (scoop install bun)"; return $false

+    $pkgJson = Join-Path $prefix 'package.json'

+        '{"name":"copilot-api-runner","private":true,"version":"0.0.0"}' | Set-Content -Path $pkgJson -Encoding utf8
+    }

+    Write-Host "copilot-proxy: installing $spec (one-time — later starts skip this) ..."
+    # Attempt 1 honours the ambient env: on a host where the npm registry is only
+    # reachable THROUGH the proxy, stripping it would break the install. Attempt 2
+    # strips it, which is what rescues the socks stall. COPILOT_INSTALL_NOPROXY=1
+    # skips straight to attempt 2 (saves the 45s stall on a known-bad host).
+    $skipFirst = ($env:COPILOT_INSTALL_NOPROXY -eq '1')

+        if (-not $skipFirst) {

+            # left it behind, and a stale lock hangs the retry for the same reason.
+            $bunHome = if ($env:BUN_INSTALL) { $env:BUN_INSTALL } else { Join-Path $HOME '.bun' }
+            Remove-Item -Recurse -Force (Join-Path $bunHome 'install/cache/.tmp') -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
+        }
+        if (-not (Invoke-CopilotPkgInstallTry -Dir $prefix -NoProxy -BudgetSeconds 90)) {
+            Write-Error "copilot-proxy: could not install $spec — run 'copilot-proxy doctor'."; return $false
+        }
+    }
+
+    if (-not (Test-CopilotPkgPresent) -or -not (Get-CopilotPkgLaunch)) {
+        Write-Error "copilot-proxy: install finished but no runnable copilot-api under $prefix."; return $false
+    }

+# Run a copilot-api subcommand (auth / check-usage / debug) in the foreground.
+# Honours $launch.Cwd so the `bun run` fallback resolves node_modules/.bin.
+function script:Invoke-CopilotPkgCommand {
+    param([Parameter(ValueFromRemainingArguments)] [string[]] $Argument)
+    if (-not (Install-CopilotPkg)) { return }

+# --- egress: which proxy should Node use for the GitHub /models fetch? --------
+#
+# copilot-api fetches /models ONCE at startup and caches it for the whole process
+# lifetime, and GitHub geo-filters the Claude catalog on some egress paths. Node
+# does NOT honour the Windows System Proxy on its own — it only sees HTTP(S)_PROXY
+# — so a host whose browser reaches the unfiltered catalog could still have the
+# proxy cache a Claude-less list, which then looks exactly like an entitlement
+# problem. Resolve the URL here and hand it to the child explicitly.
+#
+# COPILOT_HTTP_PROXY: auto|always|never|<url>. Returns a URL or $null.
+function script:Resolve-CopilotHttpProxy {
+    $mode = if ($env:COPILOT_HTTP_PROXY) { $env:COPILOT_HTTP_PROXY } else { 'auto' }
+    switch -Regex ($mode) {
+        '^(never|off|0|false|no)$' { return $null }
+        '^(http|https|socks5h?)://' { return $mode }
+        '^(always|auto|on|1|true|yes)$' { break }
+        default {
+            Write-Warning "copilot-proxy: unknown COPILOT_HTTP_PROXY='$mode' (use auto|always|never|http://...)"
+            return $null
+        }
+    }
+
+    # The Windows System Proxy (WinINET). This is what Clash Verge / mihomo /
+    # v2rayN write when their "System Proxy" toggle is on, so reading it covers
+    # the same ground the unix side gets from its Clash detector.
+    try {
+        $key = Get-ItemProperty -Path 'HKCU:\Software\Microsoft\Windows\CurrentVersion\Internet Settings' -ErrorAction Stop
+        if ($key.ProxyEnable -eq 1 -and $key.ProxyServer) {
+            # ProxyServer is either "host:port" or "http=host:port;https=host:port".
+            $server = $key.ProxyServer
+            if ($server -match '(?:^|;)\s*https?=([^;]+)') { $server = $Matches[1] }
+            elseif ($server -match ';') { $server = ($server -split ';')[0] }
+            if ($server) { return "http://$($server -replace '^https?://', '')" }
+        }
+    } catch { $null = $_ }
+
+    # Fallback: an explicit env proxy in this shell.
+    foreach ($v in $env:HTTPS_PROXY, $env:https_proxy, $env:HTTP_PROXY, $env:http_proxy) {
+        if ($v) { return $v }
+    }
+    $null
 }

+# --- specstory `-c` passthrough (why the base command must come from config) ---
+#
+# specstory's `-c/--command` REPLACES the provider's configured command — it does
+# NOT append to it. The shipped config says as much: "Use of these is equivalent
+# to -c \"custom command\"" — same slot, last write wins. So a hardcoded
+# `-c "claude $args"` silently drops every flag in `claude_cmd` the moment
+# claude-copilot has args to pass through, which made these two disagree:
+#
+#   claude-copilot-once             -> bypass-permissions  (no -c branch)
+#   claude-copilot-once --resume X  -> ~/.claude defaultMode "auto"
+#
+# Deriving the base command from the config keeps specstory the single source of
+# truth for BOTH branches. `--no-specstory` deliberately does NOT inherit it.
+
+# Effective `claude_cmd`, honouring specstory's own precedence:
+#   project ./.specstory/cli/config.toml > user ~/.specstory/cli/config.toml > `claude`
+# Matches UNCOMMENTED assignments only — both shipped configs carry a commented
+# `# claude_cmd = "claude"` example, and matching that would re-introduce the very
+# bug this exists to fix. Handles TOML's double- and single-quoted strings.
+function script:Get-SpecstoryClaudeCmd {
+    foreach ($f in '.specstory/cli/config.toml', (Join-Path $HOME '.specstory/cli/config.toml')) {
+        if (-not (Test-Path -LiteralPath $f)) { continue }
+        foreach ($line in (Get-Content -LiteralPath $f -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue)) {
+            if ($line -match '^\s*claude_cmd\s*=\s*(?:"([^"]*)"|''([^'']*)'')') {
+                $v = if ($Matches[1]) { $Matches[1] } else { $Matches[2] }
+                if ($v) { return $v }
+            }
+        }
+    }
+    'claude'
+}
+
+# Single-quote ONE argument for embedding in specstory's `-c` command STRING.
+# specstory shell-splits that string honouring quotes, so quoting is both possible
+# and necessary — an unquoted join flattens `-p "two words"` into two arguments.
+# POSIX escape for an embedded quote: close, \', reopen.
+function script:ConvertTo-CopilotShQuote {
+    param([string] $Value)
+    "'" + ($Value -replace "'", "'\''") + "'"
+}

+# Pick the best served model for Claude Code / copilot-run.

## 回答你的問題：**沒有同步**，現在補上了

`dotfiles-windows` 的 copilot pwsh port 停在 mac 端 **2026-07-09** 的狀態，之後 8 個 commit 一個都沒過去，包含 Opus 5。已全部 port 並推上 `origin/main`（`accb173`）。

### 搬了什麼

| mac commit | 內容 |
|---|---|
| `cbf5b6d` | 預設模型 → `claude-opus-5[1m]`，fallback 清單補齊 |
| `c6e0a8b` | 套件只裝一次到 `$XDG_DATA_HOME/copilot-api/pkg`，不再 `bunx` 每次重解；有時限的安裝嘗試（45s 帶 env → 90s 剝掉 proxy）、`.installed-spec` 戳記、`reinstall` 子命令、逾時回收自己生的 server |
| `74464fb` | doctor 的 Package 區段 + 卡死安裝程序偵測 |
| `1a2be50` | `COPILOT_HTTP_PROXY` + doctor 的 direct/via-proxy A/B（順帶補上原 port 漏掉的 `Get-CopilotUpstreamModel`） |
| `0b91e3b` | `Get-CopilotEnvBlock` 成為 SSOT — 原本 drift 只比 8 把 key 中的 4 把 |
| `62e254f` | `claude-copilot-once` / `copilot-here status` 顯示 drift 並詢問就地刷新 |
| `47014a7` | specstory `-c` 是**取代** `claude_cmd` 而非附加，改從設定重建 + 逐一 quote 參數 |
| `bb5f2a8` | `copilot-model --auto` |

`copilot-raycast`（904 行）依約定跳過 —— Raycast 只有 macOS。

### 兩個 Windows 特有的修正（shell 原版沒有對應問題）

移植途中實測抓到的，兩個都會在**你這台機器**上踩到：

1. **`Start-Process -ArgumentList` 不做 quoting** — 含空白的元素會被拆成兩個參數。原本打算用的 `bun run --cwd <prefix>` 在 `C:\Users\Da-Wei Lee\...` 下必爆。改用 `-WorkingDirectory` 傳路徑，參數陣列裡完全不放路徑。
2. **`Start-Process -PassThru` 的 `ExitCode` 不可信** — 實測 child `exit 7` 讀出來是 `0`，已知的 `.Handle` 快取解法也無效。原本 `return ($p.ExitCode -eq 0)` 會讓失敗的安裝寫下戳記、釘住壞掉的 prefix。改成用檔案系統驗證實際安裝結果。

### 驗證

- parse + PSScriptAnalyzer 乾淨（全 repo 只剩 3 個我沒碰過的既有警告）
- Pester **27/27**（原本 7）—— 新增涵蓋 scoped-spec 套件名陷阱、`--auto` 選擇器、drift（含 4-of-8 那個回歸）、`claude_cmd` 解析、`-c` quoting
- 真的跑了一次 `bun add` 端到端：冷啟 23.5s / 熱啟 36ms 無網路，且 `bun run` fallback 確實執行得到 copilot-api
- `copilot-here on/status` round trip 寫出 opus-5、drift 為 fixpoint
- `mkdocs build --strict` 乾淨

- 這次 push 的範圍是 `7e4429d..accb173`，除了我的 commit 之外還帶上了兩個**本地原本就沒推的** commit（`c175426` agentSounds、`2be8ffc` docs）。同分支 fast-forward，但不是我產生的。
- `.specstory/history/2026-07-13_10-00-24Z.md` 我開工前就是 modified 狀態（2026-07-13 的 session 留下的），與本次無關，**沒有**納入 commit，仍留在工作目錄。
- `copilot-here on` 印出的 URL 用 `Get-CopilotBase`、實際寫入的是 `Get-CopilotPinnedBase`（開 shim 時會差一個 port）。這是 mac 端也有的同款顯示瑕疵，為了兩邊一致我沒動 —— 要修的話應該從 mac 那側修起。

#!/bin/sh
# chezmoi modify_ script: overlay a managed herdr config onto ~/.config/herdr/config.toml.
#
# Why: herdr can rewrite this file at runtime (onboarding flag, in-app settings
# popups, [session]/[remote]/[update] state), so tracking it as a plain managed
# file would clobber that writeback and re-trigger onboarding. It was previously
# `create_` (seed-once), but that meant repo edits never reached an
# already-seeded host without a manual refresh. This modify_ overlay enforces
# our managed tables ([theme], [ui], [terminal], [keys]) on every `chezmoi
# apply` while preserving every other top-level key herdr writes back.
#
# How: chezmoi pipes the current target file into stdin; this script prints the
# new contents on stdout.
#
# Merge model — template-as-base, pull-through unmanaged keys:
#   - Base = the managed template (.chezmoitemplates/herdr/config.toml), which
#     carries the comments + the tmux-parity rationale.
#   - For every TOP-LEVEL key in the live file NOT in {theme, ui, terminal,
#     keys}, copy it into the base (preserves onboarding, [session], [remote],
#     [update], [experimental], and any future herdr writeback).
#   - Managed tables are enforced wholesale (template wins) — this is a managed
#     dotfile; in-app theme/label overrides are intentionally re-asserted.
#
# Why tomlkit (not codex's inline emitter): herdr's config has an
# array-of-tables ([[keys.command]]) and comments we want to keep; stdlib
# tomllib is read-only and the codex modify_ emitter can't emit AoT. tomlkit
# round-trips both.
#
# Note: the template is written to a temp file via a heredoc *redirect* (not
# captured with $(...)), because the config body contains a lone backtick

=== mac: 24_herdr.sh functions ===

# ── Internal helpers ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

# Parse herdr JSON output; return $null on empty/invalid instead of throwing.
function _herdr_json {

109	# --- Custom command panes (the tmux-popup recreations) ---

112	# pane's cwd and gets $HERDR_SOCKET_PATH / $HERDR_ACTIVE_PANE_ID /

123	# herdr-plus runs an action via `sh -c` with no PTY/stdin, so an interactive TUI
124	# either exits immediately (btop) or can't receive function keys like F10 (nvtop).

137	# --- Scratch shell as a real floating popup (prefix+`) ---
138	# Was type = "pane", which took over the layout — it read as a zoom of the
139	# current window rather than a scratch space. type = "popup" (herdr >= 0.7.4)
140	# floats ABOVE the tiled layout instead, so nothing reflows and quitting the
141	# shell puts you back exactly where you were.
142	#
143	# The lazygit/btop/nvtop bindings above deliberately STAY type = "pane": you
144	# quit those immediately (`q`) and return, so the temporary split costs nothing
145	# and a modal popup would buy nothing. Popups are session-modal — you cannot
146	# interact with another pane while one is open — which is the trade-off that
147	# decides this per binding rather than globally.
148	[[keys.command]]
149	key = "prefix+`"
150	type = "popup"
151	command = "$SHELL"
152	width = "85%"
153	height = "80%"
154	description = "scratch shell (popup)"
155	
156	# --- Run an arbitrary command in a floating popup (prefix+E) ---
157	# The generalisation of prefix+G: instead of a hardcoded tool, fzf-pick or type
158	# any command, run it in the FOCUSED PANE'S cwd, and the popup closes itself when
159	# the command exits. Helper: ~/.config/herdr/run-command.sh.
160	#

162	# ABOVE the tiled layout instead of splitting it, so nothing reflows and you land
163	# back exactly where you were. That is why this one is NOT type = "pane" like the
164	# lazygit/btop/scratch bindings above.
165	#
166	# Deliberately not a herdr-plus Quick Action (prefix+y): Quick Actions run through
167	# `sh -c` with no PTY/stdin (the same reason btop/nvtop are command panes) and
168	# every action is a fixed command string with no free-text field.
169	#

171	# Override with HERDR_RUN_HOLD=always|never. `--sh` runs via `sh -c` (fast, no
172	# aliases) instead of the default `$SHELL -ic` (sources the interactive rc, so
173	# this repo's aliases/functions resolve).

```text
1	#!/bin/sh
2	# chezmoi modify_ script: overlay a managed herdr config onto ~/.config/herdr/config.toml.
3	#
4	# Why: herdr can rewrite this file at runtime (onboarding flag, in-app settings
5	# popups, [session]/[remote]/[update] state), so tracking it as a plain managed
6	# file would clobber that writeback and re-trigger onboarding. It was previously
7	# `create_` (seed-once), but that meant repo edits never reached an
8	# already-seeded host without a manual refresh. This modify_ overlay enforces
9	# our managed tables ([theme], [ui], [terminal], [keys]) on every `chezmoi
10	# apply` while preserving every other top-level key herdr writes back.
11	#
12	# How: chezmoi pipes the current target file into stdin; this script prints the
13	# new contents on stdout.
14	#
15	# Merge model — template-as-base, pull-through unmanaged keys:
16	#   - Base = the managed template (.chezmoitemplates/herdr/config.toml), which
17	#     carries the comments + the tmux-parity rationale.
18	#   - For every TOP-LEVEL key in the live file NOT in {theme, ui, terminal,
19	#     keys}, copy it into the base (preserves onboarding, [session], [remote],
20	#     [update], [experimental], and any future herdr writeback).
21	#   - Managed tables are enforced wholesale (template wins) — this is a managed
22	#     dotfile; in-app theme/label overrides are intentionally re-asserted.
23	#
24	# Why tomlkit (not codex's inline emitter): herdr's config has an
25	# array-of-tables ([[keys.command]]) and comments we want to keep; stdlib
26	# tomllib is read-only and the codex modify_ emitter can't emit AoT. tomlkit
27	# round-trips both.
28	#
29	# Note: the template is written to a temp file via a heredoc *redirect* (not
30	# captured with $(...)), because the config body contains a lone backtick
31	# (`key = "prefix+\`"`) that bash mis-parses as command substitution when a
32	# quoted heredoc is nested inside $(...). Passing the path to Python sidesteps it.
33	#
34	# To manage an additional key: edit .chezmoitemplates/herdr/config.toml.
35	# Python runtime: prefer `uv` (guarantees Python >=3.11 → stdlib tomllib), fall
36	# back to system python3, then to printing the raw template unmodified (a
37	# fresh-bootstrap host with neither uv nor python3 still gets a full config —
38	# note we print the TEMPLATE, not stdin, because on a fresh host stdin is empty).
39	set -eu
40	
41	tmpl_file=$(mktemp "${TMPDIR:-/tmp}/herdr-config.XXXXXX")
42	trap 'rm -f "$tmpl_file"' EXIT INT TERM
43	
44	cat <<'TOML' > "$tmpl_file"
45	{{ template "herdr/config.toml" . }}
46	TOML
47	
48	live=$(cat)
49	
50	if command -v uv >/dev/null 2>&1; then
51	  set -- uv run --no-project --quiet --with tomlkit --python '>=3.11' python -
52	elif command -v python3 >/dev/null 2>&1; then
53	  set -- python3 -
54	else
55	  echo "modify_config.toml: neither uv nor python3 found; emitting managed template" >&2
56	  cat "$tmpl_file"
57	  exit 0
58	fi
59	
60	HERDR_TEMPLATE_FILE="$tmpl_file" HERDR_LIVE="$live" "$@" <<'PYEOF'
61	import os
62	import sys
63	
64	tmpl_path = os.environ["HERDR_TEMPLATE_FILE"]
65	with open(tmpl_path, "r") as fh:
66	    template_text = fh.read()
67	
68	
69	def emit_template():
70	    sys.stdout.write(template_text)
71	
72	
73	# Read side: stdlib tomllib (uv guarantees >=3.11); tomli backport otherwise.
74	try:
75	    import tomllib  # Python 3.11+
76	except ModuleNotFoundError:
77	    try:
78	        import tomli as tomllib
79	    except ModuleNotFoundError:
80	        # No TOML reader → can't safely merge; ship the managed template as-is
81	        # (loses runtime-key preservation, but keeps the host configured).
82	        emit_template()
83	        sys.exit(0)
84	
85	# Write side: tomlkit preserves comments + array-of-tables. uv installs it via
86	# --with tomlkit; a bare system python3 may lack it → fall back to raw template.
87	try:
88	    import tomlkit
89	except ModuleNotFoundError:
90	    print(
91	        "modify_config.toml: tomlkit unavailable; emitting managed template "
92	        "(runtime keys not preserved this run)",
93	        file=sys.stderr,
94	    )
95	    emit_template()
96	    sys.exit(0)
97	
98	MANAGED = {"theme", "ui", "terminal", "keys"}
99	
100	live_text = os.environ.get("HERDR_LIVE", "").strip()
101	doc = tomlkit.parse(template_text)  # base, with comments intact
102	live = tomllib.loads(live_text) if live_text else {}
103	
104	# Pull through every top-level key herdr owns at runtime that we don't manage.
105	for key, value in live.items():
106	    if key in MANAGED or key in doc:
107	        continue
108	    doc[key] = value
109	
110	sys.stdout.write(tomlkit.dumps(doc))
111	PYEOF
112
```
